initial_tenant_provisioning_http_500.cause: The disposable cluster had not received the runtime ACL used by the working E2E database for rotamoto.provisioning_requests.
initial_tenant_provisioning_http_500.reproduction: Before the grant, rotamoto_app SELECT on rotamoto.provisioning_requests failed with PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 42501 (permission denied); the shared E2E database grants SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE on this table.
initial_tenant_provisioning_http_500.first_service_query: Identity service reads provisioning_requests during provisionInitialOwner before creating the tenant.

mfa_confirmation_http_500_after_provisio.cause: The disposable cluster also lacked the existing E2E runtime ACL on rotamoto.recovery_tokens, which MFA enrollment confirmation updates/inserts.
mfa_confirmation_http_500_after_provisio.evidence: The fixture advanced through tenant provisioning, invitation acceptance, login and MFA enrollment, then failed at enrollment confirmation. The table was absent from the temporary app grants but had SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE in the working E2E database; granting that exact DML on the disposable cluster allowed MFA to complete.
mfa_confirmation_http_500_after_provisio.scope: Temporary cluster only; no migration or persistent database ACL changed.
